'''Cel N'ero''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. He was a known associate of [[Barin Trevina]]. Cel was a small time dealer in [[Spice/Legends|spice]] and [[Black market/Legends|black market]] items. He fancied himself as a high roller, but was in reality just a typical [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
